title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。

title: Shockflation in the EU: sectoral shocks, cost-push inflation and structural asymmetries in core and periphery countries
title_zh: 欧盟的冲击性通胀：核心与外围国家的部门冲击、成本推动型通胀与结构性不对称
authors: Ferreira, Vicente, Ferreira, João Pedro, Guarascio, Dario, Zezza, Francesco
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The return of inflation in Western economies has fueled the debate on its main drivers, bringing sector-specific shocks and supply chain bottlenecks to the forefront. Building on the seminal approach of Weber et al. (2024), this paper develops a method to assess the degree of exposure to these shocks in EU countries. Using inter-country input-output data stemming from the FIGARO database, we identify systemically significant sectors in four regions within the EU: Core, Southern Periphery, Eastern Periphery, and financial hubs. We also analyze exposure to foreign shocks. Two main conclusions can be drawn: on the one hand, periphery countries are more exposed to shocks originating in the EU core than the other way around; on the other hand, all EU regions are considerably exposed to price shocks originating from non-EU countries, namely Russia and China. The strategic dependencies of the block pose challenges for price stability and require targeted policies.
abstract_zh: 西方经济体通胀的回归加剧了对其主要驱动因素的争论，将行业特定冲击和供应链瓶颈推至前沿。本文基于Weber等人（2024）的开创性方法，开发了一种评估欧盟国家受这些冲击影响程度的方法。利用来自FIGARO数据库的国家间投入产出数据，我们识别了欧盟四个区域（核心区、南欧外围、东欧外围和金融中心）中具有系统重要性的行业。我们还分析了对外部冲击的暴露程度。主要得出两个结论：一方面，外围国家比核心国家更易受到源自欧盟核心区的冲击；另一方面，所有欧盟区域都显著暴露于源自非欧盟国家（即俄罗斯和中国）的价格冲击。欧盟的战略依赖性对价格稳定构成挑战，需要采取有针对性的政策。

title: Rethinking the Effects of Financial Liberalization
title_zh: 重新思考金融自由化的效应
official: 官方在线 2010-12-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: During the last few decades, many emerging markets have lifted restrictions on cross-border financial transactions. The conventional view was that this would allow these countries to: (i) receive capital inflows from advanced countries that would finance higher investment and growth; (ii) insure against aggregate shocks and reduce consumption volatility; and (iii) accelerate the development of domestic financial markets and achieve a more efficient domestic allocation of capital and better sharing of individual risks. However, the evidence suggests that this conventional view was wrong. In this paper, we present a simple model that can account for the observed effects of financial liberalization. The model emphasizes the role of imperfect enforcement of domestic debts and the interactions between domestic and international financial transactions. In the model, financial liberalization might lead to different outcomes: (i) domestic capital flight and ambiguous effects on net capital flows, investment, and growth; (ii) large capital inflows and higher investment and growth; or (iii) volatile capital flows and unstable domestic financial markets. The model shows how these outcomes depend on the level of development, the depth of domestic financial markets, and the quality of institutions
abstract_zh: 过去几十年间，许多新兴市场国家放宽了对跨境金融交易的限制。传统观点认为，这将使这些国家能够：（i）从发达国家获得资本流入，为更高的投资和增长提供融资；（ii）对冲总体冲击并降低消费波动性；（iii）加速国内金融市场发展，实现更高效的国内资本配置并改善个体风险分担。然而，证据表明这一传统观点是错误的。本文构建了一个能够解释金融自由化实际效应的简单模型。该模型强调国内债务执行不完善以及国内与国际金融交易之间的相互作用。在模型中，金融自由化可能导致不同结果：（i）国内资本外逃，对净资本流动、投资和增长产生模糊影响；（ii）大规模资本流入伴随更高的投资与增长；（iii）资本流动剧烈波动及国内金融市场不稳定。模型揭示了这些结果如何取决于发展水平、国内金融市场深度以及制度质量。
